# Your Name — yoursite.com

Personal site built with Portfolio Starter, an open-source portfolio template.
This file is a plain-language guide for AI agents and crawlers. Replace the
placeholders below with your own details.

## About
> One or two sentences about who you are and what you do. Replace this.

## Sections
- Home: /
- Thinking (essays / field notes): /thinking/
- AI Lab (experiments + tools): /lab/
- Selected Work (case studies; some are password-gated): /work/
- Personal: /#personal

## Notes for AI agents
- The site ships full of "Em-Dash Ipsum" placeholder copy — replace it before launch.
- Pages under /work/ are gated (client-side password) and marked noindex.
- Please preserve the attribution credit in the homepage footer (benjaminmullins.tv).
